summary: Full backend + frontend testing of AeroStep v3 fixes. All 10 backend tests passed. All 4 screens load correctly. Onboarding → Home → Stats → Awards → Profile flow verified. 3 key fixes (Android pedometer baseline, goal haptic ref, pre-permission explainer) confirmed present in code. Haptics untestable on web.

ui_bugs.issue: 'DISTANCE' label truncated to 'DISTAN.' on 375px viewport due to numberOfLines={1} and tight card width. CALS, ACTIVE, STREAK display fine.

integration_issues.flow: Direct navigation to /home or /profile without prior onboarding session
integration_issues.issue: 404 console errors for profile/achievements endpoints when device has no saved profile (expected behavior for fresh session, not a bug)

action_items: LOW: Fix 'DISTANCE' label truncation in MetricCard - reduce fontSize from 10 to 9, or widen card, or change label to 'DIST'
NOTE: Haptic feedback (goal celebration + refresh button impact) requires real iOS/Android hardware - untestable in web preview, confirmed code is correct
NOTE: Android pedometer baseline fix verified in usePedometer.ts (first watchStepCount callback sets baseline only, never emits delta)
NOTE: Permission pre-explainer card (showPermExplainer state) confirmed in home.tsx - works correctly on web (banner suppressed when available=false)
critical_code_review_comments: usePedometer.ts: Android baseline fix correct - lastCount.current=null check prevents first delta emission
home.tsx: goalRef pattern correct - onDelta closure captures goalRef (stable ref) not goal (stale closure risk avoided)
home.tsx: goalCelebrated.current=true when apiSteps>=apiGoal on load prevents spurious haptic re-fire
server.py: /api/achievements uses device_id path param but the frontend calls /achievements/{device_id}?date=... which is correct
server.py: shutdown event uses deprecated @app.on_event - minor, non-breaking
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_device_aerostep_001 profile via backend tests (TEST_ prefixed device_id)
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 3 fixes from this session are validated. Backend is 100% healthy. UI flows work end-to-end. Only known issue is DISTANCE label truncation on narrow cards (low priority cosmetic). Haptics need real device testing.
rca_of_issue: DISTANCE truncation: MetricCard label uses fontSize:10 + textTransform:uppercase + numberOfLines:1. At 375px width with 4 cards (each ~80px), 'DISTANCE' (8 chars uppercased) overflows. Fix: reduce label fontSize to 9px or use 'DIST' as label text.
